@ai-ecoverse/wasi-gh.label: GitHub CLI
@ai-ecoverse/wasi-gh.description: GitHub CLI. In seven, use GH_TOKEN from the vault; gh auth login stores a plain-text token. gh auth login -c (clipboard) needs slicc-clipboard. A git credential helper using gh auth git-credential gets no token.

@ai-ecoverse/wasix-openssh.label: OpenSSH
@ai-ecoverse/wasix-openssh.description: Connects to servers and copies files with ssh, scp and sftp; git over ssh too.

@ai-ecoverse/wasix-python.label: Python
@ai-ecoverse/wasix-python.description: Python 3.14 with pip as python3 -m pip, for scripts and data work.

@ai-ecoverse/wasix-uv-shim.label: uv
@ai-ecoverse/wasix-uv-shim.description: Python projects and virtual environments, as a shim over pip and venv.

slicc-py-datatools.label: Python data tools
slicc-py-datatools.description: numpy, pandas, scipy and matplotlib for Python, about 270 MB on disk.

@ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh.label: Node.js (jsh)
@ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh.description: Node.js 22-compatible node and jsh commands: fs (chmod included), streams, http, fetch, WebSocket, zlib, crypto and child_process, the sync calls (spawnSync, execSync, execFileSync) and detached spawns included, without fork, tls, worker or asymmetric crypto yet. fetch() reaches servers inside seven (localhost, <port>.kernel.localhost) and streams their responses. An http server's headersTimeout and requestTimeout are ignored. node with no arguments opens the REPL.

@ai-ecoverse/wasix-ruby.label: Ruby
@ai-ecoverse/wasix-ruby.description: Ruby 3.4 with gem, bundler, rake, irb and erb, for scripts and gems.

@ai-ecoverse/wasix-perl.label: Perl
@ai-ecoverse/wasix-perl.description: Perl 5.42 with cpan, perldoc and prove, for scripts and text processing. prove/TAP::Harness doesn't work yet.

@ai-ecoverse/wasi-esbuild.label: esbuild
@ai-ecoverse/wasi-esbuild.description: Bundles and minifies JavaScript and TypeScript.

@ai-ecoverse/wasi-typescript.label: TypeScript
@ai-ecoverse/wasi-typescript.description: The TypeScript 7 compiler and type checker.

@ai-ecoverse/wasi-biome.label: Biome
@ai-ecoverse/wasi-biome.description: Formats and lints JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON and CSS.

@ai-ecoverse/wasm-poppler.label: PDF tools
@ai-ecoverse/wasm-poppler.description: Reads PDFs: text, page images, and splitting or joining files.

@ai-ecoverse/wasm-qpdf.label: qpdf
@ai-ecoverse/wasm-qpdf.description: Merges, splits, rotates and encrypts PDF files.

@ai-ecoverse/wasm-libheif.label: HEIF and AVIF images
@ai-ecoverse/wasm-libheif.description: HEIC/HEIF and AVIF image decoder (heif-convert, heif-info). Includes an HEVC decoder (libde265); HEVC is patent-encumbered. LGPL-3.0-or-later.

@ai-ecoverse/wasm-rsync.label: rsync
@ai-ecoverse/wasm-rsync.description: Copies and syncs folders, sending only what changed, also to rsync:// servers.

@ai-ecoverse/wasi-buf.label: buf
@ai-ecoverse/wasi-buf.description: Lints, formats and builds Protocol Buffers.

@ai-ecoverse/wasm-screen.label: screen
@ai-ecoverse/wasm-screen.description: Keeps a terminal session running to detach and reattach, from any terminal.

@ai-ecoverse/wasi-dig.label: dig
@ai-ecoverse/wasi-dig.description: Looks up DNS records, tailnet names included.

@ai-ecoverse/wasix-gnupg.label: GnuPG
@ai-ecoverse/wasix-gnupg.description: Signs, verifies and encrypts files and commits with OpenPGP keys.
